data.narrative:
Wardstone is a seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Sebastian Fischer and Tobias Fischer that has raised $5M to date. The addressable peer universe comprises 5 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, though comparability is limited given Wardstone's early stage relative to most established players in the sector.

Three standard valuation methodologies were evaluated. Stage-progression analysis was inapplicable: the method implied a $212M valuation based on a flagged funding-tracker proxy, exceeding 20x total capital raised and failing internal sanity checks. Peer-median triangulation could not proceed due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables; while 14 same-sector peers exist broadly, fewer than three fell within applicable valuation tiers. Public-comp anchoring using the Space & Aerospace sector P/S median of 27.4x across the five public tickers could not be executed without Wardstone's revenue figure, which remains undisclosed.

Given the absence of quantitatively supportable methodologies, no triangulated valuation range can be derived from available data. A credible analysis would require either (1) revenue disclosure enabling public-comp application, (2) identification of one to two truly comparable seed-stage space ventures with disclosed valuations, or (3) disclosure of the funding terms and investor composition from the $5M round as an implicit valuation signal. Current data constraints preclude point estimation.
